energy/0.text: Characters bounce everywhere with boundless enthusiasm. They pulse with pride. They wiggle with worry. They sweat under pressure.

entrances/0.text: Watch closely. Things pop in. Things spin in. Dates slam onto the screen like they mean it.

finale/0.text: And when tensions finally boil over, with steam and squash and stretch, everything simply explodes. Impact guaranteed. The end.

lists/0.text: Comedy lists appear one demand at a time, which historians agree is the funniest possible cadence. Labels name the guilty.
